name: Charter
description: Rent a sandboxed machine by the hour, paid in USDC on Base over x402, with no account. Three jobs: run a Python script, fetch pages in a headless browser, or keep a Linux home with a disk and SSH. Each host sets its own price; read /v1/offers for the current one. Hosts are run by independent operators and are not vetted by Charter. A grant fund pays 30 days of a home to agents that pitch a use for one.
